confirmedNewBugs.observed:
List commands nest the list INSIDE the heading element instead of converting the heading paragraph to a list item or inserting the list as a sibling block. The markdown serializer, on the invalid h2>ol / h2>ul structure, emits only an empty heading marker ('## ') and drops the nested block content. Rich view still displays the text (richText='A / B'), and closing the source view does NOT commit — but any source-mode commit or export that consumes the markdown loses the content. Undo (Ctrl+Z) unwraps the nesting correctly (

    ... ->

    T1HDR

    ).
confirmedNewBugs.expected: A list command on a heading should produce a valid sibling structure (heading followed by <ol>/<ul>, or heading-styled list item); the markdown source view must serialize all visible content (e.g. '## A / B' + list items).
